title: Gone Downhill
text:
When I first signed up for the box it was great. Since the upgrade everything has gone down hill. The box itself changed to a cheap cardboard box rather than the study lift of top box that was used originally.
You would think that with the price increase the items would be better or at least more of them. The quality of items have decreased, I have yet to get the 3 full size items in every box. I will get 1-2 full size and the 3rd that they consider full size is the minimal full/trial size that they sell or the face mask they consider full size. you get less items for the increase as well.
If it does not get any better i will be cancelling the subscription.
label: negative
